title: Biblical Intertext Bundle & Composite-Memory Protocol
purpose: Prevent the Bible reader and overlap census from manufacturing a single super-passage when a project motif is actually distributed across several texts. Preserve composite memory as data while keeping textual boundaries auditable.

relation_classes.definition: The relevant functional sequence occurs within one coherent verse range, chapter or literary unit.
Several biblical texts explicitly reuse, develop or closely coordinate a motif; the relation exists across texts rather than inside one verse.
A project/user memory or symbolic configuration contains features that can be mapped to multiple biblical texts but no single passage contains the whole configuration.
A later biblical text relocates or redistributes a role found elsewhere, creating a useful counter-distribution rather than a simple match.
Several texts collectively constrain a project mapping by assigning functions differently, reversing its valence or imposing an ethical test.

required_fields_for_bundle: which features are absent from each passage
reason no single passage is sufficient
counting_rules: A composite-memory bundle is not an extra biblical verse and should not inflate unique-verse counts.
Its component overlap-relations may be separately counted only when they are analytically distinct and already satisfy census rules.
Do not count one remembered composite as N independent coincidences merely because N biblical passages are needed to reconstruct it.
If a later biblical text intentionally reuses an earlier one, genealogical dependence must be recorded rather than counted as independent textual witnesses.
If the project itself consciously borrowed a biblical cluster, high explicitness does not become high independence.

component_map.feature: angels ascending/descending localized on Son of Man
one like Son of Man approaches Ancient of Days / dominion

prototype.result: No one canonical passage should be presented as containing the full project memory. The reader should display the bundle as a constellation with explicit feature ownership.

reader_behavior: Bundle cards use tabs or a constellation view rather than concatenating verses into a fake continuous passage.
The Scripture pane must show each passage in its own canonical context.
The project pane may show the remembered composite, but it must say which text contributes each feature.
A missing component should be shown as missing rather than inferred from nearby symbolism.
Users should be able to switch from bundle view to each component passage and see its independent P/E/T/D/R/S/C/I profile where available.
higher_order_insight: Composite-memory handling turns an apparent weakness—'there is no one verse that says all of this'—into better provenance. The archive can distinguish textual convergence, later intertextual development and project-side synthesis instead of conflating them.
